    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.GradedCategory.HomGrading.part_comp_right_homogeneous {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (G : HomGrading k C) {X Y Z : C} {d : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hg : g ∈ G.component Y Z d) (t : ℤ) :

    If the last factor is homogeneous, one component of the first factor computes any prescribed component of their composite.
